Management Plan
- management_plan_main: 
  - Order general blood tests to evaluate anemia, kidney and liver function, vitamins, and other metabolic parameters
  - Reassess thyroid status (consider TSH and free T4) and evaluate thyroxine adherence; discuss potential restart of thyroid replacement if indicated
  - If blood results are unrevealing or symptoms persist, proceed with targeted physical examination and further workup as indicated
  - Monitor for red-flag symptoms (chest pain or new bowel changes) requiring urgent care
  - Provide support contact information and arrange follow-up via app/SMS; if symptoms worsen or you feel unwell, contact care team promptly

- Hypothyroidism due to non-adherence to thyroxine — Moderate-High
  - Justification: History of hypothyroidism; non-adherence after change of doctor; fatigue and weight changes; thyroid status to be clarified with labs
